thread:
maya: FYI I pushed a change to kernel-selector that prioritizes low-latency kernels for seq<32. Seeing a weird host-side p99 regression on small-chat routes.
dave: saw same. p50 unchanged, tail doubled for decode+ingress. do we have traces?
haruto: sampled perf: tokenization and http2.write are the top consumers. kvcache miss unchanged. small payload ratio increased.
maya: patch moved early tokenization to reduce GPU decode time, but it seems to fragment network writes.
dave: could be writev coalescing lost. two mitigation ideas: microcoalesce window or re-order tokenization after proto assembly.
haruto: microbench: adding 800us batching window in sidecar gets p99 down to ~15ms locally.
agent-bot: deploy scheduled: rollout 2329991111 -> rc3 at 2026-03-23T11:22:00Z
maya: plan: (1) land microcoalesce feature-flagged, (2) run prefix tokenization cache experiment, (3) add write-size histograms per-route. owners: haruto/dave/maya.
dave: will prep rollback if microcoalesce doesn't help within 1h.
